fa045d973b.q: What are the four core components of an email funnel according to Allison Hardy?
fa045d973b.a: An email funnel has four pieces: a lead magnet that solves one specific problem in exchange for an email address; a nurture sequence of emails that builds trust and shifts how subscribers think about their problem; a timed offer introduced when the subscriber is most ready with an incentive to buy now; and a pitch sequence that introduces the offer and overcomes objections.

bc2f3eee31.q: Why does Allison Hardy recommend building an email funnel even if your email list is too small?
bc2f3eee31.a: An email funnel is what grows your email list and sells to it simultaneously. Ten email subscribers who walk through a great sequence are worth more than a thousand email subscribers who hear from you twice a year. The funnel itself is designed to acquire and nurture leads while converting them.

2108fd201d.q: What five reasons does Allison Hardy give for why every entrepreneur needs an email funnel?
2108fd201d.a: You own your email list unlike social platform followers; it sells while you live your life and generates predictable revenue; it turns hope into certainty with daily leads and sales; it builds trust at each buyer's pace without high-pressure tactics; and it provides data you can act on, showing opt-in rates, open rates, click rates, and which emails drive sales.
